name: bw_plain
prompt:
A clear BLACK-AND-WHITE flat-vector diagram for a Chinese report, in THREE horizontal bands so a non-specialist reads it top to bottom. STRICTLY MONOCHROME: only pure black, white and one light gray. No color. LANDSCAPE, wider than tall, about 3:2. Pure white background. Bold crisp Chinese sans-serif typography, generously spaced. Thin precise black rules, no shadows, no gradients. Do NOT draw any overall title or caption.

On the FAR LEFT edge, three small solid BLACK label tabs, one vertically centered on each band, with WHITE Chinese text: 有什么用 / 怎么实现 / 怎么建

BAND 1 (top) — three equal WHITE boxes side by side with THICK black outlines. Each has a solid BLACK header strip with LARGE WHITE Chinese text and below it one line of black Chinese text:
Box 1 header 溯源检索 , line 找得到材料 条条有出处
Box 2 header 学术助研 , line 看得清缺口 理得出命题
Box 3 header 教材评价与合规审查 , line 评得了质量 查得出风险

BAND 2 (middle) — three WHITE boxes with THIN black outlines, each directly under the box above, each holding three short black Chinese lines with small black square bullets:
Box 1: 建材料库 收四类材料 / 按学科 学段 类型分好 / 每条必填出处
Box 2: 给材料贴标签 归入八个部分 / 自动数出哪部分材料少 / 政策 学术 史料三栏并排
Box 3: 按六个方面逐本标注 / 两人各标一遍比吻合度 / 与现行规范表述逐句比对
Draw a THICK BLACK upward arrow from each BAND 2 box into the BAND 1 box above it.

BAND 3 (bottom) — a LIGHT GRAY strip spanning the full width containing a left-to-right chain of four WHITE boxes with thin black outlines joined by THICK BLACK right-pointing arrows. Each box has a small black circled number, a bold black Chinese title and one smaller black Chinese line:
Box 1 number 1, title 搭系统 , line 委托技术团队开发 复用校内服务器
Box 2 number 2, title 建材料库 , line 三院师生标注 学生初标 教师确认
Box 3 number 3, title 上功能 , line 六个月核心 一年全部建成
Box 4 number 4, title 交运营 , line 结项后教务处承接
